summary: C4 Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 to disclose routine corporate presentation materials and a poster presentation with further Phase 1 clinical trial data for cemsidomide in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma, to be presented at the EHA 2026 Congress. The filing includes no deal terms, board recommendations, or event-driven categories—only informational updates. The press release and exhibits are furnished, not filed. This is a standard clinical-stage biotech disclosure, not a special situation.
